Moderation response with multiple categories flagged

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ModerationRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ModerationRequest::from_json(json_encode(["input" => "Extremely harmful content targeting multiple categories", "model" => "omni-moderation-latest"]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->moderate($req);
var_dump($result->getResults());
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->flagged);
```
